about: The Workbench's built-in insights: declared definitions run through plx.sql as the reader (operator_api/insights.py). No case, person or customer is named here.

insights.title: Work sent per person, last 28 days
insights.about: Per person: distinct emails sent from their work address (counted once, whichever mailboxes hold it), Teams messages they posted and meetings they organised (not cancelled), over the last 28 days. Sorted by mail plus Teams; the long tail on the right is the L-curve. Floor, lab and phone work is not seen, and mail sent from another address of theirs is not counted.
insights.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT sender, count(DISTINCT message_id) AS n FROM emails
           WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND sender IN (SELECT email FROM staff) GROUP BY 1),
     t AS (SELECT (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS pid, count(*) AS n FROM teams_messages
           WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND left(sender, 1) = '{' GROUP BY 1),
     g AS (SELECT organizer, count(DISTINCT ical_uid) AS n FROM meetings
           WHERE start_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, coalesce(m.n, 0) AS mail_sent, coalesce(t.n, 0) AS teams_sent,
       coalesce(g.n, 0) AS meetings_organised, s.person_id
FROM staff s LEFT JOIN m ON m.sender = s.email LEFT JOIN t ON t.pid = s.person_id LEFT JOIN g ON g.organizer = s.email
WHERE coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) + coalesce(g.n, 0) > 0
ORDER BY coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) DESC

insights.title: Reply time per person, last 28 days
insights.about: Messages in each person's own mailbox addressed to them (To), from someone else, not bulk, received 1 to 28 days ago: how many, how many they answered in the same thread, and the median hours to their answer (over the ones answered). People with fewer than 5 answers are left out. Fastest first.
insights.sql:
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS messages_to_them,
       count(e.owner_replied_at) AS replied,
       round(100.0 * count(e.owner_replied_at) / count(*)) AS replied_pct,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1) AS median_reply_hours,
       s.person_id
FROM emails e JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
  AND e.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email
GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id
HAVING count(e.owner_replied_at) >= 5
ORDER BY median_reply_hours NULLS LAST

insights.title: Threads waiting on each person
insights.about: Mail threads in each person's own mailbox from the last 30 days where they had written in the last 13 weeks, the latest message is to them (To) from someone else, not bulk, more than a day old, and they have not answered since. A blocker list: some are only 'thanks' notes, so open the person to see the threads.
insights.sql:
WITH st AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name, department, email FROM staff),
last AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (mailbox, thread) mailbox, thread, sender, received_at, owner_role, is_bulk, owner_replied_at
  FROM emails WHERE thread IS NOT NULL AND received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM st)
  ORDER BY mailbox, thread, received_at DESC, message_id DESC),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.mailbox, l.thread, l.sender, l.received_at FROM last l
  WHERE l.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT l.is_bulk AND l.owner_replied_at IS NULL AND l.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'),
wrote AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT mailbox, thread, sender FROM emails WHERE thread = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT thread FROM cand)) AND received_at >= now() - interval '91 days')
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS threads_waiting,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.received_at < now() - interval '3 days') AS waiting_over_3_days,
       round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - l.received_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE split_part(l.sender, '@', 2) <> split_part(s.email, '@', 2)) AS from_outside, s.person_id
FROM cand l JOIN st s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox
WHERE l.sender <> s.email
  AND (l.mailbox, l.thread, s.email) IN (SELECT mailbox, thread, sender FROM wrote)
GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id
ORDER BY threads_waiting DESC

insights.title: Who colleagues are waiting on
insights.about: Per person: mail threads in their own mailbox from the last 30 days where they had written in the last 13 weeks, the latest message is to them (To) from a colleague in the directory, not bulk, more than a day old, and they have not answered since; and one-to-one Teams chats from the last 30 days where they had written in the last 13 weeks and the latest message is a colleague's, more than a day old (group chats are not counted); how many colleagues sent those (one colleague by mail and Teams is one), how many threads and chats, how many are more than 3 days old and the oldest in days, beside the person's median hours to answer colleagues over the last 28 days (messages received 1 to 28 days ago that they answered in the same thread). Many colleagues waiting and a slow answer together mark a bottleneck. Some are only 'thanks' notes.
insights.sql:
WITH st AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name, department, email FROM staff),
last AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (mailbox, thread) mailbox, thread, sender, received_at, owner_role, is_bulk, owner_replied_at
  FROM emails WHERE thread IS NOT NULL AND received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM st)
  ORDER BY mailbox, thread, received_at DESC, message_id DESC),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.mailbox, l.thread, l.sender, l.received_at FROM last l
  WHERE l.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT l.is_bulk AND l.owner_replied_at IS NULL AND l.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
    AND l.sender IN (SELECT email FROM st)),
wrote AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT mailbox, thread, sender FROM emails WHERE thread = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT thread FROM cand)) AND received_at >= now() - interval '91 days'),
rt AS (SELECT e.mailbox, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600) AS hours
       FROM emails e JOIN st s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
       WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day' AND e.owner_role = 'to'
         AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email AND e.sender IN (SELECT email FROM st) AND e.owner_replied_at IS NOT NULL
       GROUP BY 1),
tl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (chat) chat, (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS sid, created_at,
         split_part(split_part(chat, ':', 2), '@', 1) AS pair
  FROM teams_messages WHERE right(chat, 15) = '@unq.gbl.spaces' AND message_type = 'message' AND left(sender, 1) = '{'
    AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  ORDER BY chat, created_at DESC),
tw AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT x.pid, x.sid AS colleague, x.created_at AS at FROM (
    SELECT tl.*, CASE WHEN split_part(pair, '_', 1) = sid THEN split_part(pair, '_', 2) ELSE split_part(pair, '_', 1) END AS pid
    FROM tl WHERE pair ~ '^[^_]+_[^_]+$' AND sid IN (split_part(pair, '_', 1), split_part(pair, '_', 2))
      AND created_at < now() - interval '1 day') x
  WHERE x.pid <> x.sid AND x.pid IN (SELECT person_id FROM st) AND x.sid IN (SELECT person_id FROM st)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams_messages m WHERE m.chat = x.chat AND left(m.sender, 1) = '{'
                AND m.created_at >= now() - interval '91 days' AND (m.sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' = x.pid)),
w AS (
  SELECT l.mailbox AS pid, (SELECT min(c.person_id) FROM st c WHERE c.email = l.sender) AS colleague, l.received_at AS at, 1 AS thread, 0 AS chat
  FROM cand l JOIN st s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox
  WHERE l.sender <> s.email AND (l.mailbox, l.thread, s.email) IN (SELECT mailbox, thread, sender FROM wrote)
  UNION ALL SELECT pid, colleague, at, 0, 1 FROM tw)
SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(DISTINCT w.colleague) AS colleagues_waiting, sum(w.thread) AS threads_waiting,
       sum(w.chat) AS chats_waiting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.at < now() - interval '3 days') AS waiting_over_3_days,
       round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - w.at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days,
       round(max(rt.hours)::numeric, 1) AS median_reply_hours_to_colleagues, s.person_id
FROM w JOIN st s ON s.person_id = w.pid LEFT JOIN rt ON rt.mailbox = w.pid
GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id
ORDER BY colleagues_waiting DESC, count(*) DESC

insights.title: Span of control
insights.about: Each manager in the directory and how many people report directly to them (the org chart as the directory states it; people with no manager on record are not under anyone; a person not shown on the Team page is not counted).
insights.sql: SELECT m.name AS manager, m.department, m.person_id, r.person_id AS report_id FROM staff r JOIN staff m ON r.manager_email = m.email ORDER BY m.name

insights.title: Levels in the org chart
insights.about: How many people sit at each level below the top of each reporting chain (level 1: a manager with no manager on record), from the directory's manager links; a person not shown on the Team page is not counted.
insights.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
  SELECT name, email, person_id, 1 AS level FROM staff WHERE manager_email IS NULL AND reports_count > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.name, s.email, s.person_id, c.level + 1 FROM staff s JOIN chain c ON s.manager_email = c.email WHERE c.level < 20)
SELECT level, person_id FROM chain ORDER BY level

insights.title: Team shape: people, managers and span per department
insights.about: Per department in the directory: people, managers (people with direct reports), the largest and average span of control, and people with no manager on record (an empty department is shown as (none)). The org chart is only as complete as the directory's manager links: a team where most people have no manager on record is not mapped there.
insights.sql:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(department, ''), '(none)') AS department, count(*) AS people,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE reports_count > 0) AS managers, max(reports_count) AS largest_span,
       round(avg(reports_count) FILTER (WHERE reports_count > 0), 1) AS average_span,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE manager_email IS NULL) AS no_manager_on_record
FROM staff GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY people DESC, 1

insights.title: Leader scorecard: each manager's team, last 28 days
insights.about: Per manager in the directory (someone with direct reports): direct reports, the whole team under them at every level (the leader not counted), how many of the team sent any mail or Teams message, what they sent (distinct emails from their work address plus Teams messages), the busiest member's share of it, and for mail addressed (To) to team members in their own mailboxes from someone else, not bulk, received 1 to 28 days ago: how many, the share answered in the same thread and the median hours to the answer; then the same reply rate and median hours for the manager's own mailbox. The team is only as complete as the directory's manager links, and a member whose mailbox is not captured adds no mail.
insights.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE st AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT person_id, name, department, email, manager_email, reports_count FROM staff),
tree AS (
  SELECT m.person_id AS leader, r.person_id AS member, r.email, 1 AS depth FROM st m JOIN st r ON r.manager_email = m.email
  UNION
  SELECT t.leader, r.person_id, r.email, t.depth + 1 FROM tree t JOIN st r ON r.manager_email = t.email WHERE t.depth < 20),
team AS (SELECT DISTINCT leader, member FROM tree WHERE member <> leader),
inb AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.mailbox, e.owner_replied_at, extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600 AS hours
  FROM emails e JOIN st s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
  WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
    AND e.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email),
m AS (SELECT sender, count(DISTINCT message_id) AS n FROM emails
      WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND sender IN (SELECT email FROM st) GROUP BY 1),
t AS (SELECT (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS pid, count(*) AS n FROM teams_messages
      WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND left(sender, 1) = '{' GROUP BY 1),
work AS (SELECT st.person_id, coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) AS n FROM st LEFT JOIN m ON m.sender = st.email LEFT JOIN t ON t.pid = st.person_id),
tm AS (SELECT x.leader, count(*) AS messages, count(i.owner_replied_at) AS replied,
              percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.hours) AS median_hours
       FROM team x JOIN inb i ON i.mailbox = x.member GROUP BY 1),
tw AS (SELECT x.leader, count(*) AS people, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.n > 0) AS active, sum(w.n) AS sent, max(w.n) AS busiest
       FROM team x JOIN work w ON w.person_id = x.member GROUP BY 1),
own AS (SELECT mailbox, count(*) AS messages, count(owner_replied_at) AS replied,
               percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hours) AS median_hours FROM inb GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.name AS leader, l.department, l.reports_count AS direct_reports, tw.people AS team_size,
       tw.active AS team_active, tw.sent AS team_sent,
       round(100.0 * tw.busiest / nullif(tw.sent, 0)) AS busiest_member_share_pct,
       tm.messages AS team_messages_to_them, round(100.0 * tm.replied / nullif(tm.messages, 0)) AS team_replied_pct,
       round(tm.median_hours::numeric, 1) AS team_median_reply_hours,
       round(100.0 * own.replied / nullif(own.messages, 0)) AS leader_replied_pct,
       round(own.median_hours::numeric, 1) AS leader_median_reply_hours, l.person_id
FROM st l JOIN tw ON tw.leader = l.person_id LEFT JOIN tm ON tm.leader = l.person_id LEFT JOIN own ON own.mailbox = l.person_id
ORDER BY tw.people DESC, l.name

insights.title: Reply time and reply rate per department, last 28 days
insights.about: Per department: mail addressed (To) to its people in their own mailboxes from someone else, not bulk, received 1 to 28 days ago; how many they answered in the same thread and the median hours to the answer. Many To messages need no answer (notices, thanks), so the rate is a comparison between teams, not a target. People with no department are shown as (none).
insights.sql:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(none)') AS department, count(DISTINCT s.person_id) AS people,
       count(*) AS messages_to_them, count(e.owner_replied_at) AS replied,
       round(100.0 * count(e.owner_replied_at) / count(*)) AS replied_pct,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM e.owner_replied_at - e.received_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1) AS median_reply_hours
FROM emails e JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox
WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND e.received_at < now() - interval '1 day'
  AND e.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT e.is_bulk AND e.sender <> s.email
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY median_reply_hours NULLS LAST

insights.title: Workload balance per department, last 28 days
insights.about: Per department in the directory: people, how many sent any mail or Teams message in the last 28 days, what they sent (distinct emails from their work address plus Teams messages), the median per person who sent any, the busiest person's count and share, and how few people send half of it (1 means one person sends at least half). Floor, lab and phone work is not seen. People with no department are shown as (none).
insights.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT sender, count(DISTINCT message_id) AS n FROM emails
           WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND sender IN (SELECT email FROM staff) GROUP BY 1),
     t AS (SELECT (sender::jsonb) ->> 'id' AS pid, count(*) AS n FROM teams_messages
           WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND left(sender, 1) = '{' GROUP BY 1),
     w AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(none)') AS department, coalesce(m.n, 0) + coalesce(t.n, 0) AS n
           FROM staff s LEFT JOIN m ON m.sender = s.email LEFT JOIN t ON t.pid = s.person_id),
     r AS (SELECT department, n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY n DESC) AS rank,
                  sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY n DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running,
                  sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS total FROM w)
SELECT department, count(*) AS people, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n > 0) AS active, sum(n) AS sent,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n) FILTER (WHERE n > 0))::numeric, 1) AS median_per_active_person,
       max(n) AS busiest_person, round(100.0 * max(n) / nullif(sum(n), 0)) AS busiest_share_pct,
       min(rank) FILTER (WHERE total > 0 AND 2 * running >= total) AS people_sending_half
FROM r GROUP BY department ORDER BY sent DESC, department

insights.title: Mail sent by our people per week
insights.about: Distinct emails sent from a staff work address per week (Monday start, business time zone), the last 12 weeks: the company's outgoing mail pulse.
insights.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', e.received_at AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(DISTINCT e.message_id) AS mail_sent FROM emails e JOIN staff s ON s.email = e.sender WHERE e.received_at >= (date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}') - interval '12 weeks') AT TIME ZONE '{business_tz}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

insights.title: Customers by mail, last 28 days
insights.about: Customers by the number of distinct non-bulk emails about them or from them in the mail you can read over the last 28 days, with the threads and how many came from outside our domain. A customer is linked to a message by the mail's customer links.
insights.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, count(DISTINCT e.message_id) AS messages, count(DISTINCT e.thread) AS threads, count(DISTINCT e.message_id) FILTER (WHERE e.sender_domain IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(s.email, '@', 2)) AS from_them FROM emails e JOIN customers c ON c.handle = ANY(e.customers) LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = e.mailbox WHERE e.received_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND NOT e.is_bulk GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY messages DESC LIMIT 25

insights.title: Customers waiting on us
insights.about: Customers whose latest message in a thread to one of our people (in that person's own mailbox, addressed to them, not bulk) has had no answer from that person for more than a day, over the last 30 days: how many threads, how many of our people they wait on, and the oldest wait in days. A colleague's answer from another mailbox is not seen unless that person was copied.
insights.sql: WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.mailbox, e.thread) e.mailbox, e.thread, e.sender, e.sender_domain, e.received_at, e.owner_role, e.is_bulk, e.owner_replied_at, e.customers FROM emails e WHERE e.thread IS NOT NULL AND e.received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND e.mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM staff) ORDER BY e.mailbox, e.thread, e.received_at DESC, e.message_id DESC) SELECT c.name AS customer, count(*) AS threads_waiting, count(DISTINCT l.mailbox) AS people_waited_on, round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - l.received_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days FROM last l JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox JOIN customers c ON c.handle = ANY(l.customers) WHERE l.owner_role = 'to' AND NOT l.is_bulk AND l.owner_replied_at IS NULL AND l.sender <> s.email AND l.sender_domain IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(s.email, '@', 2) AND l.received_at < now() - interval '1 day' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY threads_waiting DESC, oldest_days DESC LIMIT 25

insights.title: Waiting on someone outside, per person
insights.about: Threads in each person's own mailbox from the last 30 days where they wrote the latest message, to at least one address outside our domain, more than 3 days ago, and nobody has written in the thread since: what they are waiting on others for, and the oldest in days. Some are closing notes that need no answer.
insights.sql: WITH last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.mailbox, e.thread) e.mailbox, e.thread, e.sender, e.received_at, e.to_addresses FROM emails e WHERE e.thread IS NOT NULL AND e.received_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND e.mailbox IN (SELECT person_id FROM staff) ORDER BY e.mailbox, e.thread, e.received_at DESC, e.message_id DESC) SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS threads_waiting, round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - l.received_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days, s.person_id FROM last l JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = l.mailbox AND l.sender = s.email WHERE l.received_at < now() - interval '3 days' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(l.to_addresses) a WHERE split_part(a, '@', 2) <> split_part(s.email, '@', 2)) GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id ORDER BY threads_waiting DESC

insights.title: Open Planner tasks per person
insights.about: Microsoft Planner tasks not completed, per person they are assigned to (a task with two assignees counts for each): how many are open, how many are past their due date, and how many of those are more than 90 days past it (often tasks nobody closed).
insights.sql: SELECT s.name AS person, s.department, count(*) AS open_tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(r.fields->>'due_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'due_at')::timestamptz < now()) AS overdue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(r.fields->>'due_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'due_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '90 days') AS overdue_90_days, s.person_id FROM records r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.fields->'assignees') = 'string' THEN (r.fields->>'assignees')::jsonb ELSE r.fields->'assignees' END) a(pid) JOIN staff s ON s.person_id = a.pid WHERE r.type = 'PlannerTask' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'completed_at', '') = '' GROUP BY s.name, s.department, s.person_id ORDER BY open_tasks DESC

insights.title: Approvals decided in Mission Control, last 30 days
insights.about: Mission Control approval requests decided in the last 30 days, per person who decided: how many approved and how many rejected. Who asked and what for is on each request (Ask: 'which approvals did <name> reject this month?').
insights.sql: SELECT coalesce(s.name, r.fields->>'decided_by') AS decided_by, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.fields->>'status' = 'approved') AS approved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.fields->>'status' = 'rejected') AS rejected FROM records r LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.email = lower(r.fields->>'decided_by') WHERE r.type = 'MCApproval' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'decided_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'decided_at')::timestamptz >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

insights.title: Approvals still waiting for a decision
insights.about: Mission Control approval requests with no decision yet, per person who asked: how many are waiting and the oldest in days.
insights.sql: SELECT coalesce(s.name, r.fields->>'requested_by') AS requested_by, count(*) AS waiting, round((max(extract(epoch FROM now() - (r.fields->>'requested_at')::timestamptz)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS oldest_days FROM records r LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.email = lower(r.fields->>'requested_by') WHERE r.type = 'MCApproval' AND r.fields->>'status' = 'pending' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'requested_at', '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

insights.title: How fast approvals are decided, last 30 days
insights.about: Mission Control approval requests decided in the last 30 days, per person who decided: how many, the median minutes from the request to the decision, the hours within which nine in ten were decided, the share decided within an hour, and how many were rejected.
insights.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT lower(r.fields->>'decided_by') AS who, r.fields->>'status' AS status,
                  extract(epoch FROM (r.fields->>'decided_at')::timestamptz - (r.fields->>'requested_at')::timestamptz) / 60 AS minutes
           FROM records r WHERE r.type = 'MCApproval' AND coalesce(r.fields->>'decided_at', '') <> ''
             AND coalesce(r.fields->>'requested_at', '') <> '' AND (r.fields->>'decided_at')::timestamptz >= now() - interval '30 days')
SELECT coalesce(s.name, a.who) AS decided_by, count(*) AS decided,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.minutes))::numeric, 1) AS median_minutes,
       round((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.minutes) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS slowest_tenth_hours,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.minutes <= 60) / count(*)) AS within_an_hour_pct,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'rejected') AS rejected
FROM a LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.email = a.who GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY decided DESC

insights.title: Decisions in mail and Teams, last 14 days
insights.about: Decisions, agreements and confirmations stated in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 14 days, newest first: who decided and what, and how many days ago. Each is a model's one-line reading of one message (Ask to see the message itself).
insights.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(f.who, ''), f.sender) || ': ' || f.summary AS decision, round((extract(epoch FROM now() - f.said_at) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS days_ago, f.topic, f.source, f.handle FROM comms_findings f WHERE f.kind = 'decision' AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '14 days' ORDER BY f.said_at DESC LIMIT 100

insights.title: Who decides, asks and complains, by department, last 30 days
insights.about: Decisions, requests and complaints found in the mail and Teams messages of the last 30 days, counted by the department of the person who wrote the message (from the directory: their work address for mail, their account for Teams). Messages from outside PLX are counted as (outside); a PLX sender the directory has no department for as (no department). Each finding is a model's one-line reading of one message.
insights.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.person_id IS NULL THEN '(outside)' ELSE coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(no department)') END AS department,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'decision') AS decisions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'request') AS requests,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'complaint') AS complaints, count(DISTINCT s.person_id) AS people
FROM comms_findings f
LEFT JOIN staff s ON (f.source = 'email' AND s.email = f.sender)
                  OR (f.source = 'teams' AND left(f.sender, 1) = '{' AND s.person_id = (f.sender::jsonb) ->> 'id')
WHERE f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY decisions DESC, requests DESC

insights.title: How each team decides, last 30 days
insights.about: Per department of the person who stated a decision in mail or Teams (from the directory; outside senders left out), last 30 days: decisions, how many people stated them, the share stated by the one who stated most, the share stated by a manager on record (someone with reports), how many followed an earlier request in the same thread or chat, the median hours from that request to the decision, how many of those requests came from another team or outside, and how many were taken to the asker's own manager (only where the directory names the asker's manager), with the latest example. Each finding is a model's one-line reading of one message; a team with few managers on record shows fewer of them.
insights.sql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.kind, f.summary, f.said_at, f.thread, f.source, s.person_id, s.email, s.manager_email, s.reports_count,
         CASE WHEN s.person_id IS NULL THEN '(outside)' ELSE coalesce(nullif(s.department, ''), '(no department)') END AS department,
         coalesce(nullif(f.who, ''), s.name, f.sender) AS by_whom
  FROM comms_findings f
  LEFT JOIN staff s ON (f.source = 'email' AND s.email = f.sender)
                    OR (f.source = 'teams' AND left(f.sender, 1) = '{' AND s.person_id = (f.sender::jsonb) ->> 'id')
  WHERE f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND f.kind IN ('decision', 'request') AND f.thread IS NOT NULL),
d AS (SELECT * FROM f WHERE kind = 'decision' AND department <> '(outside)'),
dr AS (SELECT d.*, q.said_at AS asked_at, q.department AS asked_department, q.manager_email AS asker_manager
       FROM d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.said_at, r.department, r.manager_email FROM f r
                                 WHERE r.kind = 'request' AND r.thread = d.thread AND r.source = d.source
                                   AND r.said_at < d.said_at ORDER BY r.said_at LIMIT 1) q ON true),
top AS (SELECT department, max(n) AS top_n FROM (SELECT department, person_id, count(*) AS n FROM d GROUP BY 1, 2) x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT dr.department, count(*) AS decisions, count(DISTINCT dr.person_id) AS deciders,
       round(100.0 * max(top.top_n) / count(*)) AS top_decider_pct,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.reports_count > 0) / count(*)) AS by_a_manager_pct,
       count(dr.asked_at) AS after_a_request,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM dr.said_at - dr.asked_at) / 3600))::numeric, 1) AS median_hours_to_decide,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.asked_at IS NOT NULL AND dr.asked_department <> dr.department) AS asked_by_another_team,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.asker_manager IS NOT NULL AND dr.asker_manager = dr.email) AS taken_to_their_manager,
       (array_agg(dr.by_whom || ': ' || dr.summary ORDER BY dr.said_at DESC))[1] AS latest_example
FROM dr JOIN top USING (department)
GROUP BY dr.department ORDER BY decisions DESC

insights.title: Complaints and praise from outside, by topic, last 90 days
insights.about: Complaints and praise from customers, suppliers and other outside parties in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 90 days, counted per topic (delivery, quality, pricing ...). Read by a model from each message; our own staff's messages are left out.
insights.sql: SELECT f.topic, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'complaint') AS complaints, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'praise') AS praise FROM comms_findings f WHERE f.kind IN ('complaint', 'praise') AND f.from_side IN ('customer', 'outside') AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY f.topic ORDER BY complaints DESC, praise DESC

insights.title: Latest complaints from outside, last 30 days
insights.about: The complaints customers, suppliers and other outside parties made in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 30 days, newest first: who (the customer when the message is linked to one) and what, and how many days ago.
insights.sql: SELECT coalesce((SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.handle = ANY(f.customers) ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 1), nullif(f.who, ''), f.sender) || ': ' || f.summary AS complaint, round((extract(epoch FROM now() - f.said_at) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS days_ago, f.topic, f.handle FROM comms_findings f WHERE f.kind = 'complaint' AND f.from_side IN ('customer', 'outside') AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY f.said_at DESC LIMIT 100

insights.title: What customers and suppliers asked us for, last 30 days
insights.about: Requests customers, suppliers and other outside parties made in the mail and Teams messages you can read over the last 30 days, counted per topic, with the last 7 days beside. Read by a model from each message; our own staff's requests to each other are left out.
insights.sql: SELECT f.topic, count(*) AS requests, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.said_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS last_7_days FROM comms_findings f WHERE f.kind = 'request' AND f.from_side IN ('customer', 'outside') AND f.said_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY f.topic ORDER BY requests DESC
